caption: today's sky: moon in aquarius, venus opposite uranus. tomorrow at 13:00 utc mars stations retrograde at 10° virgo.

slides.headline: *mars* turns retrograde tomorrow, *8 am*. today: moon in *aquarius*
a little *distance* is healthy today
slides.body: an aquarius moon reads as cool and curious. talk to a friend before you talk to the person you're overthinking.

slides.headline: venus opposes *uranus*: expect a plot twist
slides.body: astrologers read this as sudden chemistry or sudden cancellations. enjoy it. don't sign anything.

slides.headline: *mars* goes still, then starts backing up
slides.body: the station is the slowest moment. read it as a day to not push. finish what's open first.

slides.headline: send the honest text *today*. not tomorrow.
